_doc: Algs written with their triggers in parentheses, e.g. "U (R U R' U') (R U' R')". Only these groups are shown as triggers for that alg (replacing its automatic closing insert); an alg written with no parentheses shows none. Each group must be a named trigger (TRIGGER_NAMES in shared/catalog.ts: 3-move insert, sledgehammer, hedgeslammer, sexy move), named from its shape. Rebuild with: npm run build-catalog
